question: A company adds a user to Microsoft 365. Existing user groups do not have the required permission sets for newly added users. You need to assign a Dynamics 365 Business Central user group and permissions to the user and the company. Which five actions should you perform in sequence?
alternatives: Select Get New Users from Microsoft 365 / Update Users from Microsoft 365.
Select the user from the user list.
Assign the user group to the user.
Assign the company to the user.
explanation: Business Central users are synchronized from Microsoft 365 before they can be managed in the Business Central Users page. After the user exists in Business Central, create the user group and add the required permission sets to that group. Finally, select the user and assign the group. The company assignment is intentionally a distractor here: it is not one of the required actions in this sequence.

question: A company uses Dynamics 365 Business Central. When users create sales documents, the system must display an alert that shows the customer's remaining credit and also notify the user if the customer has overdue payments. What should you do?
alternatives: Configure the Late Payment Predict extension.
Select Both Warnings in the Credit Warnings field.
Enable the Exact Cost Reversing Mandatory field.
explanation: The Credit Warnings field on the customer controls which credit-related messages appear when users create sales documents. Selecting Both Warnings makes Business Central check both the customer's remaining credit and overdue customer ledger entries. Block Customer is used to prevent activity, while Late Payment Predict is a separate prediction feature and does not configure these two standard warnings.

question: You configure a cloud-based printer in Dynamics 365 Business Central. Purchase orders printed by users must automatically print to the cloud-based printer. On which page should you create the setup record for the user, report, and printer combination?
explanation: Printer Selections determines which printer Business Central uses for a particular user and report. A setup record can associate the purchase order report with the cloud-based printer, so printing a purchase order automatically uses that printer. Printer Management administers available printers, while Report Layout Selection controls the report layout rather than the physical or cloud printer destination.

question: You are implementing Dynamics 365 Business Central Online. Users must be added to Business Central for the first time. Which action should you use?
alternatives: Create a new entry on the User Setup page
explanation: The Business Central user list is synchronized with Microsoft 365. Update Users from Microsoft 365 imports new users and refreshes changed user information after administrators make changes in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. User Setup and User Groups configure Business Central behavior and permissions after the users have been imported; they do not perform the initial synchronization.

question: You set up a new company for a customer. The customer provides an Excel file containing master data. You need to import the master data by using configuration packages. Which four actions should you perform in sequence?
alternatives: Export an Excel template and populate the data.
Import a populated Excel template into the package data.
explanation: Configuration packages use table and field definitions to move master data into a company. First export an Excel template and populate it with the customer's data. Then create the configuration package, import the completed workbook into the package data, review or validate the records, and apply the data. Importing directly into sales header and lines is not the configuration-package process described here.

question: You are setting up approval workflows in Dynamics 365 Business Central. You need to configure approver limits. Match each requirement to the correct approver limit type.
targets: Route approval requests to the approver defined in Approval User Setup, regardless of the amount.
Route approval requests to the approver defined in the Workflow Response, regardless of the amount.
Route approval requests to a user who can approve requests for the required amount.
explanation: Direct approver routes the request to the approver specified in Approval User Setup. Specific approver routes it to the user named by the workflow response. First Qualified approver evaluates the approval limits and selects a user who is qualified to approve the requested amount. Approver Chain is used when approval should move through a chain of users rather than selecting the first qualified user.

question: A company uses Dynamics 365 Business Central and wants to print financial statements by using a cloud-based printer. Which type of printer should you recommend?
explanation: The Email printer type is appropriate when a report must be delivered through a cloud-based service rather than sent to a locally attached printer. Business Central can create the report output and send it through the configured email or cloud delivery path. System, Client default, and Server default refer to different local or server printing behaviors and do not meet this cloud-based financial-statement requirement.

question: You create a test instance of Dynamics 365 Business Central and enter transactions for testing. You create a production company in the same environment. You need to copy setup and master data from the test instance to production without copying transaction data. What are two possible ways to achieve the goal?
alternatives: Use the Run Migration Now function from Cloud Migration Management.
Create and export a configuration package from the source company, then import it into the destination company.
Use the Copy Data from Company function from the Configuration Worksheet page.
Use the Copy function from the Companies page.
explanation: A configuration package can be exported from the test company and imported into the production company, allowing selected setup and master tables to be transferred without copying posted transactions. Copy Data from Company on the Configuration Worksheet provides another controlled way to copy configuration and master data. Cloud Migration Management is for migration scenarios, and the general Companies page Copy function does not provide the required transaction-data separation.

question: You are creating companies for multiple customers in the cloud-based version of Dynamics 365 Business Central by using the assisted setup guide. Match each company requirement to the correct template.
targets: Create a company that has setup data and sample data.
Create a company that does not have setup data.
Create a blank company that has setup data but does not have sample data.
explanation: The Evaluation template is intended for demonstrations and includes both setup data and sample data. Create New creates a blank company without the standard setup data. Production creates a blank operational company with the setup data needed for implementation but without demonstration sample data. Choosing the template based on the intended starting content avoids having to remove sample records from a production company.

question: You are implementing Dynamics 365 Business Central. The customer wants to upload starting entries for all master data through a general journal on the last day of the current month. Which three functions should you select?
explanation: Opening-balance functions create general-journal entries for the existing vendor balances, customer balances, and G/L account balances at the specified posting date. These functions preserve the subledger detail needed for accounts payable and accounts receivable while also establishing the general ledger opening amounts. Calculate Inventory is an inventory calculation function, and Get Standard Journals retrieves reusable journals rather than loading these three categories of starting balances.

question: You are setting up and testing a workflow with approval hierarchy in Dynamics 365 Business Central. In Approval User Setup, you configure the following users. The workflow uses the approver limit type Approver Chain. User1 creates a purchase order for $1,100 and sends an approval request. Which set of actions occurs?

rows: User4 is configured as a direct approver for User1.

alternatives: User4 will receive an approval request. Once approved, the purchase order is released.
User3 receives an approval request. Once User3 approves the request, the purchase order is released.
User2 will receive an approval request. Once User2 approves the request, User3 will receive an approval request. Once User2 and User3 approve the request, the purchase order is released.

User1 will receive an approval request. Once User1 approves the request, User2 must approve the request. Once User2 approves the request, User3 must approve the request. Once User3 approves the request, the purchase order is released.
User3 will receive an approval request. Once User3 approves the request, the request is routed to User4 for approval. Once User4 approves the request, the purchase order is released.
explanation: With Approver Chain, Business Central routes the request through approvers whose limits are reached in sequence. User2 can approve $1,100 only up to $1,000, so User3 must also approve it. User4's direct-approver setup does not replace the approval chain for this request.

question: A company implements Dynamics 365 Business Central. The database contains very few posted entries, and Global Dimension 1 is configured incorrectly. You need to run the Change Global Dimensions function in Sequential mode to replace Global Dimension 1. Which four actions should you perform in sequence?
alternatives: Sign out of Business Central, and then sign back in.
Select the Change Global Dimensions action.
explanation: Open General Ledger Setup, start Change Global Dimensions, select the replacement dimension, and then run the process. In Sequential mode, sign out and back in after the process so the changed global dimension is available to the session.

question: A customer has premium licenses for Dynamics 365 Business Central. You need to make all actions and fields for the Manufacturing and Service modules available to users. What should you do?
alternatives: Assign users to the D365 BUS FULL ACCESS user group.
Select the Premium option in the Experience field on the Company Information page.
Assign SUPER permission sets to users.
Assign users to the D365 BUS PREMIUM user group.
Select the Custom option for the Company Badge field on the Company Information page.
explanation: The Experience field on Company Information controls whether the Premium manufacturing and service functionality is available. Select Premium when the customer has premium licenses.

question: You manage several companies within one Dynamics 365 Business Central database. Most users work in only one company, where they have a specific role. Match each security requirement to the setup that provides it.
targets: Assign a role center to a user.
Define the active profiles for a company.
Allow users to work only within their own company.
Set record security to limit user rights to view data from a table.
explanation: User Personalization assigns a role center to a user. Profile (Role) defines active profiles. Users and User Groups can restrict users to their assigned companies, while Permission Sets and Permissions control table and record access.

question: You are implementing an approval system by using email notifications. Match each notification requirement to the setup that provides it.
targets: Specify how the user receives notifications about approval requests.
Specify that the user receives notifications on a weekly basis.
explanation: Approval User Setup identifies approval administrators. Notification Setup controls how approval notifications are delivered, and Notification Schedule controls their frequency.

question: You are unable to view some expected functionality in Dynamics 365 Business Central. In which three places can you assign profiles to users?
alternatives: Assign a User Group to the user. Assign the Profile to the User Group.
Assign a Profile on the User Personalization page.
Assign the Profile on the User card.
Add the user to the Profile card.
explanation: Profiles can be assigned through a user's User Personalization record, through a User Group, or by accepting the default profile. The User card and Profile card are not the applicable assignment locations in this question.

question: A customer currently sends quotes and invoices using postal services and wants to send them by email directly from Business Central. What are two possible ways to configure outbound email?
alternatives: Run the Set up your Business Inbox in Outlook assisted setup tool.
Run the Set up email logging assisted setup tool.
Run the Email setup assisted setup tool.
explanation: Outbound email can be configured through SMTP Mail Setup or the Email setup assisted setup guide. The Business Inbox and email logging guides do not configure outbound document email.

question: A company uses Dynamics 365 Business Central to record payments for vendors. All payment records include similar data elements. You are onboarding a new vendor and must create a unique number series for payments from that vendor. No other vendors will use the new number series. What should you use?
explanation: A General Journal template defines recurring journal behavior and can provide the number series used for a particular type of payment journal. A template is appropriate when similar payment records share the same structure.

question: You need to create a new company configured similarly to an existing company. The existing company has data that must be used as a template for the new company. Match each requirement to the tool that provides it.
targets: Create the first essential data components of a company, such as the company name.
Run a series of setup tasks in a specific order and manually mark the tasks as completed once the tasks are finished.
Template the existing data and apply the template to the new company in a single process.
explanation: Assisted Setup creates the initial company components. A Configuration Questionnaire organizes setup tasks in order and lets you mark them complete. RapidStart Services templates existing data and applies it to the new company.

question: You create a role center page for all users in Dynamics 365 Business Central. Users must not be allowed to personalize the page. Which three actions should you perform?
alternatives: On the Profiles (Role) page, select the profile and select the User as the default profile option.
On the User card, set the status to Disabled.
On the Profiles (Role) page, select the profile and select the Show in Role Explorer column.
On the Profiles (Role) page, select Enable the profile. Disable all other profiles.
On the Profiles (Role) page, select the profile and select the Disable Personalization option.
explanation: Set the role as the default user profile, make it available in Role Explorer, and disable personalization for the profile. Disabling a user is unrelated to role-center configuration.
